alloy: all s: Spec | ((no a: Axiom | cites[s, a]) and (no t: Spec | cites[s, t])) implies s in Freelancing
all e: Exception | (no s: Spec | cites[e, s]) implies e in Freelancing
all e: Exception | (no f: Fact | cites[e, f]) implies e in Freelancing

alloy: all u: Unit | circular[u] implies u in Cycle

all b: Bug | hidden[b] implies b in Finding
all t: Test | misleading[t] implies t in Finding

alloy: all c: Claim | tested[c] implies c not in Untesting
doubt: Generic 'a tested claim' read as every tested claim.

all d: Document | ((some f: Listing | d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel)) and d not in Given) implies (no p: Plugin | p->d in Over.rel)

all f: Frontmatter | f not in Listing implies (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel)
all d: Document | (some f: Refused | d->f in Head.rel) implies (d in Unreadable and (all r: Run | r in Exits2))
all d: Document | (some f: Refused | d->f in Head.rel) implies d in Unreadable
all r: Run | (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) implies r in Exits2
all r: Run, p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2 implies r in Exits2
all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits1

all d: Worded, u: Unit | (d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported

all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten

all u: Unit | u in Handwritten implies u not in Rewritten
all w: Word | (some u, v: Unit | u != v and u->w in Rely.rel and v->w in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart
doubt: 'used in one unit' read as Rely (a claim, definition or fact of the unit uses it); generic 'a word' as every word. Apart's reading speaks of the reading's unit, not the using unit, so the statement may not match the author's intent.

alloy: all w: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Rely.rel)) implies w in Unused

all w: Word | ((some t: Term | t->w in Introduce.rel and t->w in Voice.rel) and (some u: Unit | u->w in Rely.rel)) implies (w not in Flagged and w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused)

all d: Document, u1: Unit, w1: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u1 in Hold.units and u1->w1 in Introduce.rel) implies (w1 not in Undeclared and w1 not in Misplaced and w1 not in Apart and w1 not in Unused and w1 not in Flagged)
all s: Trial, c: Scenario, u: Unit | (s->c in Pose.scenario and s->u in Leave.rel) implies (u in Held and s->u not in Pose.units and (all v: Held | v != u implies s->v in Pose.units))

doubt: 'for which the author asks about leaving out no unit' taken literally as no Probe for c; it may have been meant otherwise (e.g. the author does not ask about any particular unit).

alloy: all s: Search, c: Scenario, u1: Unit | (s in Trial and s->c in Pose.scenario and s->u1 in Leave.rel and (some u2: Unit | c->u2 in Probe.rel)) implies c->u1 in Probe.rel

all d: Document, u: Unit | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies (no w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel)

some u1: Unit, d1: Document | d1 in Worded and d1->u1 in Hold.units and u1 in Logical and u1 in Current and u1 not in Reported

all l: Series | l in Many implies l in AsBullets

all l: Series | l in TooLong implies l in AsBullets

some q: Quantifier | q in VariableOnce and q in ConditionAside
some q: Quantifier | q in VariableWithCondition and q in NothingToAttach
